fit_reason: Whole boat (2002 Lund Fisherman 1700 aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer) listed by a private owner.
findings: Painted aluminum hull sides look somewhat dull and flat in the sun, especially the dark upper band near the stern
Light grime and staining on the lower transom area around the motor mount
Outboard cowling has a slightly faded, hazy look rather than a deep gloss
Floor carpet in the bow and cockpit looks dusty with light marks
Seats and interior panels look generally clean, with only light dust
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund Fisherman 1700. It looks well kept, but the dark hull paint and the Yamaha cowling look a bit dull in the photos, and the carpet could use a deep clean. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, polish and wax on the hull and motor plus an interior cleanup, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
